Subject: PO requirements and invoicing cadence for annual commitment

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has been asked to align billing and PO requirements before we can move to signature. A couple of constraints from our side: 

- Payment terms: net60 preferred (finance mandate).
- Invoicing cadence: weekly invoice runs preferred (we need smaller incremental invoices to match internal cost-centers).
- PO metadata: must include BILL_TO_ENTITY, PROJECT_CODE, GL_ACCOUNT, and a PO-level contact email.
- Discount request: procurement is asking whether a pricing discount can be applied for an annual committed spend of ~$500k (they referenced an 8% target).

Can Redwood accept net60 with weekly invoice runs? If there are packaging or billing requirements we should follow (PO field names, which entity to bill, header format), please send a short checklist so our AP team can provision it into our system.

We can share a draft PO once we confirm the field names. Looking to get this on procurement's agenda next week.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Kim

procurement@novatech.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoicing cadence for annual commitment

Hi Daniel —

Appreciate the clarity. Short answers up front: we can support net60 and weekly invoice runs, but there are a few conditional items that will help avoid reconciliation friction on both sides. Below is what we typically require and a proposed packaging/discount approach so procurement can see options.

Required PO fields (exact text we validate):
- PO_NUMBER
- BILL_TO_ENTITY
- LEGAL_ENTITY_ID (if you have multiple NovaTech legal entities)
- PROJECT_CODE
- GL_ACCOUNT
- BILLING_CONTACT_EMAIL

Notes: these are case-sensitive in our ERP ingest. If you can supply the PO in Excel (we've attached a template in a follow-up from Sales), we can map automatically.

Invoicing cadence tradeoffs:
- Weekly runs: best for your cash-flow visibility, but increases our bill-run overhead; because of that we ask that single-week invoices consolidate all usage for that week under the same PO_NUMBER to avoid many micro-credits.
- Monthly runs: lower ops overhead and fewer line-item disputes; if procurement prefers monthly we can offer a smoother reconciliation path.

Packaging / discount options (draft):
- Option 1 (Standard Commitment): 5% discount at $250k annual committed spend.
- Option 2 (High Commitment): 8% discount at $500k annual committed spend, requires signed blanket PO and the PO metadata above.
- Early-pay incentive: if invoices are paid Net30 vs Net60 across the year, we can add a 1.5% invoice-level credit applied after quarter close.

Ben (cc'd) will follow up with a formal pricing attachment and our PO template you can drop into your system. Vanessa, can you confirm ops is comfortable with weekly runs if the PO template is followed exactly?

If this looks reasonable, Daniel, say "yes" to Option 2 and we'll send the pricing PDF + PO template and a DocuSign bundle for the blanket commitment.

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Hi Daniel —

Thanks, Sergio — I've attached a short pricing proposal and an editable PO template to make integration with your AP system straightforward. Attachment stubs below.

Quick summary of the commercial options (all dollars are list; discounts apply to usage-based token pricing and embeddings):

- Option A: Mid Commitment
  - Commitment: $250k annual
  - Discount: 3% off list
  - Invoicing: weekly or monthly (no extra incentives)

- Option B: Enterprise Commitment (recommended)
  - Commitment: $500k annual
  - Discount: 7% off list
  - Early-pay credit: +1.5% applied retroactively if average invoice payment across the year moves to Net30 (we can apply quarterly true-ups)
  - Requirements: signed blanket PO, PO fields exactly as listed by Sergio, and an initial deposit invoice for the first month (optional).

Operational PO field checklist (copy/paste to your AP team):
- PO_NUMBER
- BILL_TO_ENTITY
- LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
- PROJECT_CODE
- GL_ACCOUNT
- BILLING_CONTACT_EMAIL
- PAYMENT_TERMS (use NET60 or NET30)

Attachments included:
- Novatech_pricing_proposal.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
- PO_template_NovaTech.xlsx (XLSX, single-tab template with header mapping)

DocuSign / SOW: We can bundle the blanket commitment + SOW and send a DocuSign link within 24 hours of you confirming Option B. If legal needs redlines, please route them to contracts@redwood.com and we'll fast-track review.

One last note: weekly invoice runs are fine, but please ensure each week's invoice uses the same PO_NUMBER for the week and includes the PROJECT_CODE to avoid matching errors in our system.

Looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
